name: Apollo
description: Apollo is a unified engagement platform that is the foundation for your entire end-to-end sales strategy. Teams get access to a database of over 200 million contacts, as well as a host of different engagement and analytics tools.

events.d: Create a new account and set domain, owner, stage, phone, address, and custom fields.
Create a contact (requires first and last name) and set email, company, phones, labels, and custom fields.
Create a new deal and set owner, account, amount, close date, stage, and custom fields.
Create and assign a task with type, status, due date, owner, contact, priority, title and note.
Update an account's name, domain, phone, address, owner, stage, or custom fields.
Search contacts using filters, pagination, labels, stages, and selectable response fields.

events.n: When a new account is created in Apollo
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new account is created in Apollo.

events.n: When a new contact is created in Apollo
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new contact is created in Apollo.

events.n: When an existing contact is updated
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever an existing contact is updated.
Update an existing contact's details like name, email, phones, company, labels, and custom fields.
Update a deal's fields such as name, amount, close date, owner, account, stage, and custom fields.
Find a person in Apollo using an email address.
Retrieve company details by domain, website, LinkedIn URL, or name. Optionally select response fields to return.
Retrieve all account stages from Apollo. No configuration required.
Retrieve all contact stages from your Apollo account.
Retrieve deals from Apollo with pagination, sorting, and selectable response fields.
Retrieve the IDs for the available deal stages in your team's Apollo account.
Retrieve linked teammate email inboxes and choose which details to return.
Search email sequences by name and return selected fields, with paging options.
Add contacts (by list or label) to an email sequence and select sender, status, and advanced options.
Removes contacts from selected sequences by choosing sequences, contact IDs, and mode.
Search accounts by organization, stage, label, sorting, and pagination.
Find people in Apollo's database using filters like job title, location, employer, technologies, and job postings.
Find multiple people using identifiers like email, name, domain, LinkedIn URL, or Apollo ID.
Retrieve a person's Apollo profile by Person ID and optionally select which response fields to return.
Search companies by name, domain, industry, location, funding, and hiring filters and return company details.
